# MY Hardware & Construction Supply

> Official online catalog and warehouse liquidation platform for MY Hardware & Construction Supply (formerly Manna Hardware). Serving contractors, builders, hardware resellers, and homeowners across Tacloban City, Leyte, and Samar, Philippines.

## Core Offerings & Inventory
- [Structural & Building Materials](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=catalog&cat=Structural+%26+Building+Materials): C-purlins (2x4, 2x6, 1.2mm, 1.5mm, 2.0mm), 6mm angle bars, plain bars 16mm, deform bars, rebar.
- [Plumbing & Sanitary Fixtures](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=catalog&cat=Plumbing+%26+Fixtures): Schedule 40 GI pipes, PPR pipes and fittings, PVC orange/blue fittings, brass gate & swing valves.
- [Paints & Industrial Coatings](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=catalog&cat=Paints+%26+Coatings): Island Paint, Davies, Bosny spray paints, zinc chromate primers, wood stains.
- [Fasteners & Bulk Hardware](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=catalog&cat=Fasteners+%26+Hardware): Black gypsum screws (100 pcs/pack), blind rivets, tox, welding rods, cutting discs.

## Volume Wholesale Tiers & Liquidation Pricing
- [10% OFF Automatic Tier](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=promotions): Instant discount on orders ₱10,000+
- [20% OFF Contractor Tier](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=promotions): Automatic Contractor Wholesale Tier on orders ₱25,000+
- [35% OFF Builder Tier](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=promotions): Builder Tier on orders ₱50,000+ (Promo Code: BUILDER)
- [40% OFF Commercial Reseller](https://myhardware.mikashop.online/?tab=promotions): Commercial Reseller Maximum Tier on orders ₱100,000+ (Promo Code: HARDWARE)

## Warehouses & Fulfillment
- Cabalwan Depot (CAB): Tacloban City, Leyte
- Nula Tula Depot (NT): Tacloban City, Leyte
- Priority Warehouse Pickup: Direct contractor self-haul from Tacloban depots with loading assistance.
- Jobsite Trucking Freight: Available upon request across Leyte and Samar.
